cases.actual: "Saved Discount applied."; account_balance_wallet Balance 222,000.00 → account_balance_wallet Balance 212,000.00

cases.title: Record a part-payment against an invoice
steps: On Somto Obi's invoice press Record payment.
Method Bank Transfer, reference "GTB-448812", amount ₦100,000, allocate ₦100,000 to the invoice.
cases.expected: The receipt page opens with a receipt number NPS/RCP/<year>/<n>, ₦100,000, Bank Transfer and the allocation; the invoice becomes Partially Paid with balance ₦112,000.
cases.actual: Receipt NPS/RCP/2026/0019; invoice Partially Paid, account_balance_wallet Balance 112,000.00.

cases.title: Allocations cannot exceed the amount received
steps: Open Record payment; pupil Kamsi Eze; method Cash; amount ₦5,000.
cases.expected: An "Over-allocated" warning; nothing is saved.
cases.actual: Refused: "Over-allocated Allocations exceed the payment amount."

cases.title: Payments register and receipt
cases.expected: Receipts are listed with pupil, method, reference and status; the filter narrows to bank transfers; the receipt shows amount, method, reference and the invoice it paid.
cases.actual: 19 receipts; 8 bank transfers; receipt opened (qr_code_2 Reference GTB-448812).

cases.title: Refund a payment restores the invoice balance
cases.expected: "Payment refunded."; the receipt shows Refunded; the invoice balance returns to ₦212,000 and its status to Issued.
cases.actual: Balance after refund: account_balance_wallet Balance 112,000.00

cases.title: A discount cannot push a paid invoice into a negative balance
cases.preconditions: Chiamaka Okafor's invoice is paid in full (₦257,000).
steps: Enter a ₦10,000 discount on the Tuition line and press Tab.
cases.expected: The discount is refused (the invoice is already settled; a refund or credit is the right tool), and the balance stays ₦0.00 — never negative.
cases.actual: Discount accepted: account_balance_wallet Balance 0.00 → account_balance_wallet Balance -10,000.00 (message "Saved Discount applied.")

cases.title: Store dashboard highlights low stock
cases.expected: 10 items in the catalogue, 2 below reorder level (HB pencils: 3 on hand vs 5; Whiteboard markers: 4 vs 6) listed under "Low stock — needs replenishing", stock value by category and recent movements.
cases.actual: inventory_2 Items in catalog 10 / 10 | warning Below reorder level 2 | account_balance_wallet Stock value 941,000.00; low-stock list: HB pencils, Whiteboard markers.

cases.title: Catalogue search and low-stock filter
cases.expected: Low stock only shows the 2 low items with a "Low" badge; the search finds the two Primary 5 textbooks.
cases.actual: Low stock only → 2; "textbook" → 2.

cases.title: Add a new item with an opening balance
steps: Name "Crayons (12 colours)", SKU ST-CRY-I5FGB, category Stationery, unit Box, reorder level 5.
cases.expected: "'Crayons (12 colours)' added."; the item page shows On hand 20, last unit cost ₦1,500, stock value ₦30,000 and an Opening Balance movement.
cases.actual: "Saved 'Crayons (12 colours)' added."; inventory On hand 20.00 BOX; account_balance_wallet Stock value 30,000.00.

cases.title: SKUs are unique
steps: Press New item; name "Pencils (duplicate)", SKU "ST-PEN-HB" (already used), category Stationery, unit Box.
cases.expected: "An item with SKU 'ST-PEN-HB' already exists."
cases.actual: Refused: "Failed An item with SKU 'ST-PEN-HB' already exists."

cases.title: Receive a purchase from a supplier
steps: Item HB pencils, type Purchase, quantity 20, unit cost ₦950, reference "LPO-2701", supplier Lagos Book Hub Ltd.
cases.expected: Saved; HB pencils on hand rises from 3 to 23 and the item is no longer low; the dashboard shows 1 item below reorder level.
cases.actual: "Saved Movement recorded."; inventory On hand 23.00 BOX; dashboard warning Below reorder level 1.

cases.title: Issue a textbook to a pupil
steps: Item Primary 5 English textbook, type Issue, quantity 1, pupil Kamsi Eze.
cases.expected: Saved; on hand falls from 59 to 58; the movement history shows the issue to Kamsi Eze.
cases.actual: inventory On hand 58.00 EA; history: NPS/STK/2026/0022 30 Sep 2026 ISSUE −1.00 EA To pupil Kamsi Eze 0.00

cases.title: Cannot issue more than is on hand
steps: Item Whiteboard markers (4 on hand), type Issue, quantity 50, class Primary 5A.
cases.expected: Refused with a clear message such as "Cannot remove 50 — only 4 are on hand."; stock is unchanged.
cases.actual: The message is garbled: "Failed Cannot remove 50.000 4.000 are on hand."

cases.title: Movement log with filters
cases.expected: Every movement is listed with number, item, type, quantity, counter-party and cost; the filter shows only issues (to pupils and classes).
cases.actual: 22 movements; 5 issues.
